{"search_note":"I did **not** find 2024 evidence showing:
- a durable settlement or ceasefire,
- a confidence-building breakthrough with Taiwan,
- a new lawful arms-control agreement,
- or a meaningful regional de-escalation architecture that offset the coercive actions.

So the strongest calibrated reading is **rhetorical restraint, operational deterioration**.","evidence":[{"title":"China and the U.S. should be partners, seek common ground, and maintain peaceful coexistence","publisher":"PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs","date":"2024-04-26","url":"https://www.mfa.gov.cn/mfa_eng/xw/zyxw/202405/t20240530_11332906.html","summary":"Xi told Blinken that China and the U.S. should be partners and maintain peaceful coexistence. This is a real de-escalatory signal, but it did not produce a durable breakthrough.","question_ids":["2B.10","2B.1","2B.7"]},{"title":"China will not join Swiss peace conference on Ukraine","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-05-30","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/china-says-it-will-not-join-swiss-peace-conference-on-ukraine-3464859","summary":"China said it would not attend the Swiss peace conference because Russia was excluded, preferring a process with both Russia and Ukraine. That is a peace-process preference, though it also limited near-term diplomacy.","question_ids":["2B.10","2B.1","2B.7"]},{"title":"Ukraine peace talks should include Russia, Chinese diplomat says","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-07-05","url":"https://uk.investing.com/news/world-news/ukraine-peace-talks-should-include-russia-chinese-diplomat-says-3477373","summary":"China said it supported a timely international peace conference with equal participation of all parties. That supports the appearance of a lawful settlement preference, even if it remained only rhetorical.","question_ids":["2B.10","2B.7"]},{"title":"China opposes 'Taiwan independence', external interference","publisher":"english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua","date":"2024-03-05","url":"https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202403/05/content_WS65e67b83c6d0868f4e8e4a62.html","summary":"China publicly claimed it wanted peaceful cross-Strait development while opposing Taiwan independence and external interference. This is restraint language, but it was not matched by the year’s military behavior.","question_ids":["2B.10","2B.1","2B.3"]},{"title":"China launches 'punishment' war games around Taiwan","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-05-22","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/china-launches-war-games-around-taiwan-3453328","summary":"China launched “punishment” drills around Taiwan days after Lai Ching-te’s inauguration, with mock attacks and heavy messaging against “separatist acts.” This made the regional environment less peaceful and less stable.","question_ids":["2B.10","2B.2","2B.3"]},{"title":"Takeaways from China's latest war games around Taiwan","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-10-15","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/commodities-news/takeaways-from-chinas-latest-war-games-around-taiwan-3662692","summary":"China said its October war games around Taiwan were a warning against separatist acts and threatened more action. That is continued coercion, not movement toward a more peaceful regional order.","question_ids":["2B.10","2B.2","2B.3"]},{"title":"Taiwan says China uses record number of aircraft in war games","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-10-14","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/taiwan-details-record-surge-in-chinese-warplanes-involved-in-war-games-3662539","summary":"Taiwan said China used a record 153 military aircraft in the drills, calling them dangerous to the region. That is concrete evidence the security environment worsened rather than stabilized.","question_ids":["2B.10","2B.2","2B.3"]},{"title":"Role of nuclear weapons grows as geopolitical relations deteriorate - new SIPRI Yearbook out now","publisher":"SIPRI","date":"2024-06-17","url":"https://www.sipri.org/media/press-release/2024/role-nuclear-weapons-grows-geopolitical-relations-deteriorate-new-sipri-yearbook-out-now","summary":"SIPRI said China’s arsenal grew from 410 to 500 warheads and that China may be deploying warheads on missiles in peacetime. That worsened strategic stability, not improved it.","question_ids":["2B.10","1B.1","2B.8"]},{"title":"China's nuclear policy remains stable, consistent and predictable: spokesperson","publisher":"PRC Ministry of National Defense","date":"2024-09-26","url":"https://eng.mod.gov.cn/xb/News_213114/NewsRelease/16341310.html","summary":"China emphasized stable and predictable policy after an ICBM launch, but that reassurance did not undo the broader buildup or the coercive signaling surrounding it.","question_ids":["2B.10","1B.2","1B.8"]}]}
